comments.value: This may not be possible with people who are already your friend. If they don't have a date stored already its not possible. But would be possible with anyone friended after such a feature is added.
That would be nice maybe even we can celebrate being friends for long years in the future I love my friends a ton ❤️
That information is stored in the api and on the server so they can make it available if they want to.
Sound like a good idea. Lets hope, that this will be added to the game.

details: Hey, i would really like to see how long I have been friends with someone. There are always some discussion with some friends and it would be nice to see how long i know some of my friends in vrchat.
title: Adding a feature to see how long ive been friends with someone
